description_full: Kuber Resources Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, distribution, and sale of wood panels; as well as provides formaldehyde treatment services in China. The company also provides treatment of flame retardant wood panels through a patented process, as well as act as an intermediary for buying and selling of commodities. The company was formerly known as Uonlive Corporation and changed its name to Kuber Resources Corporation in November 2022. Kuber Resources Corporation is headquartered in Admiralty, Hong Kong.

financial_summary: Kuber Resources Corporation is a micro-cap industrials business with a $126,045 market cap on $4M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +58% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 50% against a 8% cost of capital — a 42-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat. Gross margins of 89% confirm genuine pricing power.
The company is burning through $394,220 of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 64% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and within its sector the business captures 2.2× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
